name: ci-fixture
why: The gold slice of the `index-serve-gate` CI job and of the stranger's end-to-end path (specs/aw-index-serve-gate.md section 3/4). 24 golds, authored for this slice from the sealed fixture documents of data/index-fixture/ (7 families: fedlex_exact, loda_exact, dila_kali, service_public_fiche, stackexchange_nonso_qa_p0, openalex_academic_dump, stackoverflow_qa; no court decision is in the slice, whose texts stay held). The dila_kali, service_public_fiche, stackexchange_nonso_qa_p0, openalex_academic_dump and stackoverflow_qa stages are the ones `aw source run FAMILY --from data/samples/... --out ...` makes (slice 7), and the test builds from that output, not from a copy; the dila_kali stage holds ONE document, the service_public_fiche stage six fiches, the stackexchange_nonso_qa_p0 stage seven passages, the openalex_academic_dump stage ten and the stackoverflow_qa stage ten, so their golds probe the plumbing of those families and say nothing about ranking among many. They are NEW: none is copied from a gold file of data/, they are never used for tuning, and they name no person. The gate scores them over HTTP against `aw serve` on an index built by `aw index build` from those fixtures. Changing this file changes its sha256, which a baseline verdict pins: a changed slice needs a new baseline, on purpose.
licence: Apache-2.0 for the queries and the structure of this file (the repository licence). Each gold's target is a URL, not text: the documents it points at are reproduced, for the fixture only, under the licence in `licence` of the family below.

fedlex_exact.source: Fedlex, SR 0.631.256.916.31 (Swiss-Austrian agreement on border traffic, ELI cc/1948/195_183_155), DE/FR/IT, from a recorded set of the official replies (one small act, three languages)
fedlex_exact.licence: official federal legal act, not protected by copyright (URG Art. 5 para. 1 lit. a); consent and licence basis declared in data/source-family-contracts.v1.json

loda_exact.source: DILA LEGI (Legifrance), three in-force texts of the national law corpus, from the eight-article sample data/samples/legi-loda/ (three of them are in force and long enough to index)

dila_kali.source: DILA KALI (Legifrance), one in-force collective-agreement article (an accord of the textile branch on vocational training, 2004) from the two-file sample data/samples/dila-kali/ (the second file is not in force and is excluded, with its reason)

service_public_fiche.source: Service-Public.fr information sheets (DILA, "Vos droits et demarches"): six whole fiches cut from the publisher's open-data archive by tests/fixture_tools/cut_service_public_fiche.py, in data/samples/service-public-fiche/ (the sheets name an institution, no natural person)
service_public_fiche.licence: Licence Ouverte / Etalab-2.0 (the publisher's own dump licence; data/samples/service-public-fiche/SOURCE.md)

stackexchange_nonso_qa_p0.source: Stack Exchange Data Dump, Information Security site: six questions and seven answers from the 13-row sample data/samples/stackexchange-nonso/ (every owner a placeholder, no user profile in the sample)
stackexchange_nonso_qa_p0.licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 and 4.0 (the version of each answer's own row; attribution in data/samples/stackexchange-nonso/SOURCE.md)

openalex_academic_dump.source: OpenAlex works snapshot, one parquet part: ten scholarly works (title, metadata and abstract) cut whole from the part by tests/fixture_tools/cut_openalex.py, in data/samples/openalex-academic/
openalex_academic_dump.licence: CC0 1.0 (OpenAlex data dedication; the abstracts are third-party text that OpenAlex redistributes under it; data/samples/openalex-academic/SOURCE.md)

stackoverflow_qa.source: Stack Exchange Data Dump, Stack Overflow: ten questions with their accepted answers from the 24-row sample data/samples/stackoverflow-qa/ (every selected post owned by a deleted account, no user profile in the sample), cut by tests/fixture_tools/cut_stackoverflow_qa.py
stackoverflow_qa.licence: Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 2.5, 3.0 and 4.0 (the version of each post's own row; attribution in data/samples/stackoverflow-qa/SOURCE.md)
